rows.label: Monthly tax deduction (MTD/PCB): computerised formula for normal remuneration
rows.value: Monthly tax deduction (MTD/PCB) = [(P − M) × R + B − (Z + X)] ÷ (n + 1), where P is the projected chargeable income for the year after EPF (up to RM4,000) and reliefs, M, R and B come from the income tax scale table, Z is zakat and X the MTD already deducted this year; additional remuneration (bonus, arrears) uses a separate formula
